🌌 Anima Lab Documentation Index

This document provides a functional overview of the documentation. Each entry describes the core information contained within the guide and its current implementation status.

🧭 The Status Pattern

Every guide is accompanied by a [filename]_status.md file used for technical validation.

  • ✅ Match: Concept fully implemented.
  • ⚠️ Partial / In Progress: Implementation is incomplete or evolving.
  • ℹ️ Conceptual / UI-Driven: Design goals/UX patterns.

🧬 Access & Identity

The foundation of the security model, managing user identities and project-scoped access.

  • Overview: The fundamental identity anchor and scoped access model. [Status: ✅ Match]
  • Project Member: Roles and membership within a specific project. [Status: ✅ Match]
  • Project Token: Secure, hashed keys for automated system access. [Status: ✅ Match]
  • User: The central identity anchor for all system interactions. [Status: ✅ Match]

🏗️ Architecture & Infrastructure

The technical blueprints for core patterns, permissions, and performance.

  • Enums: Core type definitions and integer-based state management. [Status: ⚠️ Partial]
  • Identity System: The mechanism for identity anchoring and synchronization. [Status: ✅ Match]
  • Permissions: The authorization engine (Brain, Muscle, Law) and access gates. [Status: ⚠️ Partial]
  • Schema: Entity configuration patterns and polymorphic ownership logic. [Status: ✅ Match]

  • Performance: Query optimization, pagination, and infrastructure requirements. [Status: ✅ Match]
